  • Classes in io.milvus.v2.service.vector.request.highlighter used by io.milvus.v2.service.vector.request.highlighter 
    Class and Description
    Highlighter
    A highlighter used by the search API to mark the matched terms in the returned text fields.
    LexicalHighlighter
    A lexical highlighter used by the search API to highlight the terms of the search query that match the returned text fields, based on lexical (BM25) matching.
    LexicalHighlighter.HighlightQuery
    A single highlight query that specifies the field to highlight and the query text used to match the highlighted terms.
    LexicalHighlighter.LexicalHighlighterBuilder
    Builder for LexicalHighlighter.
    SemanticHighlighter
    A semantic highlighter used by the search API to highlight the passages of the returned text fields that are semantically relevant to the queries, using an embedding model.
    SemanticHighlighter.SemanticHighlighterBuilder
    Builder for SemanticHighlighter.
